title: Practice 4: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: He made me cry.
exercises.why: **довёл** — past tense (masculine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Have you gone completely mad?
exercises.why: **сошел** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The vase was broken to pieces.
exercises.why: **разлетелась** — past tense (feminine) of разлететься: perfective (imperfective partner: разлетаться).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **влетела** — past tense (feminine) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: A cockroach has climbed up on me!
exercises.why: **залез** — past tense (masculine) of залезть: perfective (imperfective partner: залезать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: A mouse came into the room.
exercises.why: **вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom climbed out of the pool.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: You have caused me to lose my temper.
exercises.why: **вывел** — past tense (masculine) of вывести: perfective (imperfective partner: выводить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I took the children to school.
exercises.why: **отвёл** — past tense (masculine) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **залетела** — past tense (feminine) of залететь: perfective (imperfective partner: залетать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: We swam across the channel.
exercises.why: **переплыли** — past tense (plural) of переплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: переплывать).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: The baby crept into the room.
exercises.why: **заполз** — past tense (masculine) of заползти: perfective (imperfective partner: заползать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Mayuko entered the room.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He was taken off on a stretcher.
exercises.why: **унесли** — past tense (plural) of унести: perfective (imperfective partner: уносить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: He got out from under the car.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Susan left an hour ago.
exercises.why: **ушла** — past tense (feminine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom dismounted his motorcycle.
exercises.why: **слез** — past tense (masculine) of слезть: perfective (imperfective partner: слезать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: They've crossed the road.
exercises.why: **перешли** — past tense (plural) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Mary went berserk.
exercises.why: **пришла** — past tense (feminine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom converted to Catholicism.
exercises.why: **перешёл** — past tense (masculine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).
